asked.question: It says "(Nest hostel Family)" and picks up at Duque Nest. Which hostel is the flyer for?
asked.answer: All hostels, with pick-up at Duque Nest

asked.question: It says both "Today 2 spots left" and "Everyday". A flyer for every day, or for today only?
asked.answer: Every day, reusable; "2 spots left" only in the share text

asked.question: How should the flyer tell people to reserve: at reception, or with the phone number?
asked.answer: The phone number on the flyer

notes: Chain-wide (hostel null): the tour is offered to the whole Nest family, and Duque Nest is only the pick-up point, so WHERE carries it as the place ("Pick-up point": "Pick-up & drop-off" broke as "drop- / off" in the chip). Evergreen: the tour runs every day, so the flyer says EVERY DAY and stays valid; today's urgency (2 spots left) lives only in the share text, where staff can change it. The ask prints the first number (Artur's answer); both numbers are in the share text. Times turned to 24 h (5:45pm → 17:45, 11pm → 23:00). Cost: transport and the picnic are what the price buys; the 9-seat van became the extra "Only 9 seats". The highlights (Roques de García, Paseo Lunar, Mirador de Samara) don't fit the flyer's four short extras and stay in the share text. The staff's "reserve your place now" kept in the share text (not "Book now"). Since 2026-10-06 the flyer follows Artur's own corrections of it on the live site: no full stop ends a title line, and the share text is English first, then the line "-- 🇪🇸 --", then Spanish. His line "🇪🇸 Español abajo 👇" after the hook tells a Spanish reader to scroll: for a long caption. His other change to the live flyer, the ask's own words, is not taken here: it was not asked for as a rule. WHEN prints the range since 2026-10-06, as Artur wrote it on the live flyer and then made a rule: "17:45-23:00", a hyphen and no spaces, which does not break in the chip as "17:45 – 23:00" did.
